note: Trend-filtered RSI(2) Mean Reversion (community/GitHub concept, Strategy 4). Entry: Daily SMA(200) uptrend AND RSI(2) <= 10 on 4H, next 4H bar open. Exit: RSI(2) >= 70 (dynamic exit in runner) or 60-bar time exit. No static stop by spec. Baseline thresholds only - RSI threshold sweep (5/10/15/20) explicitly forbidden.

signal.evaluatedAfter: 4H bar close confirmed; daily candle fully closed (runner-injected)
signal.exitExpression: RSI(2) >= 70 OR time exit after 60 bars

sources: Community: RSI(2) mean-reversion filters on 4H crypto (freqtrade/backtrader public strategies)
